scripts.dev: npm run build && wrangler dev --config wrangler.migracao.jsonc
scripts.migracao:test: node scripts/check-migracao-worker.mjs && node scripts/check-migracao-frontend.mjs && node --test tests/migration/*.test.js
scripts.verify:production: npm run check:migrations && npm test && npm run test:design && npm run test:bootstrap-admin && npm run build && node scripts/check-migracao-build.mjs
scripts.deploy:cloudflare: npm run check:migrations && wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --remote && wrangler deploy --config wrangler.jsonc
scripts.deploy: npm run verify:production && npm run deploy:cloudflare
